scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p api/tsconfig.json && uv run --project sdks/python --frozen pyright
scripts.lint: biome check . && uv run --project sdks/python --frozen ruff check sdks/python scenarios/runners/python && uv run --project sdks/python --frozen ruff format --check sdks/python scenarios/runners/python
scripts.format: biome check --write . && uv run --project sdks/python --frozen ruff format sdks/python scenarios/runners/python
scripts.check:deps: depcruise server codegen sdks/typescript scenarios scripts --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs
